question: The systemic action of TNF generates in the liver:

options.opa: The activation of acute phase proteins.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: TNF -> Activation of acute phase proteins -> 80% CHAIN: TNF -> Cachexia -> 70% CHAIN: TNF -> Production of lipopolysaccharide -> 60% CHAIN: TNF -> Synthesis of prostaglandins -> 80%
analysis: TNF (tumor necrosis factor) is known to stimulate the liver to produce acute phase proteins as part of the systemic inflammatory response.
